summary: Master corporate governance, legal risk, and board dynamics. Join our expert-led Women in Governance and Legal Leadership training to advance your career.
lede: Governance and legal leadership training prepares women in legal, compliance and board-facing roles to connect legal risk with effective organizational oversight. Participants practise identifying fiduciary and enterprise risks, evaluating board performance, and developing approaches to ESG and AI governance. The syllabus also covers compliance controls, crisis response, financial oversight and stakeholder engagement, helping learners apply legal expertise to practical governance challenges.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for high-achieving professionals who operate at the intersection of law, ethics, and corporate strategy.
modules: Fiduciary Duties and Legal Risk Management
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level course. Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in a legal, compliance, or governance role. A basic understanding of corporate law and organizational structure is required. No prior experience with specific governance software is necessary, as all technical tools will be introduced during the sessions.
